sources.title: Quantum Extremal Surfaces: Holographic Entanglement Entropy beyond the Classical Regime

evidence.text: Define quantum extremality by vanishing generalized-entropy variation in both normal directions. Quantum trapped surfaces have strictly negative variation along every future-directed null generator; marginally trapped surfaces have zero variation. These definitions reduce to their classical counterparts as ħ→0.

evidence.text: Compute modular flow through Rindler transformations and evaluate entropy by integrating infinitesimal Noether charges in phase space. The explicit Chern–Simons integration varies constant BTZ parameters U,V and fixes its additive constant using the vacuum equal-lightcone-length interval.
